A '''skirmish''' occurred on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Prelude==
A group of [[Shamed Ones]] managed to steal a ship from an [[Intendant caste|Intendant]] and headed to Dagobah in search of the world of prophecy.

Originally on Dagobah to go to the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]], [[Tahiri Veila]] soon found herself followed by [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==The skirmish==
The Shamed Ones, hunted by the warriors, teamed up with Tahiri. The Shamed Ones were armed with [[Club/Legends|clubs]], which, compared to the Warrior's [[Amphistaff]]s, put them at a disadvantage.

The battle didn't last long, as soon it was down to Tahiri and a [[Hul Qat|tracker of the Shamed Ones]] versus three Warriors. Tahiri dispatched two warriors and the tracker managed to impale the last Yuuzhan Vong (who was also the leader) on his own Amphistaff.

==Aftermath==
Tahiri and the tracker, who revealed his name to be Hul Qat, hid while Hul asked if Dagobah was the planet their [[Prophet/Legends|Prophet]] saw. Knowing he would die soon, Tahiri lied and told him it was, and Hul asked for her to tell [[Nom Anor|Yu'shaa]] about it, to which Tahiri truthfully promised she would.
